_source: driver/badline.py. 20 cpuhistory captures a board 40 frames apart for 0042/0335/9795 (--captures 20 --stride 40), so the per-frame mean covers ~800 frames of the run rather than its first 15; 12 back-to-back captures for 9795_frozen and 16 for 9795_march (--warmup 112, the play loop inside one 274578-cycle $1887 march). Each instructions unstolen cost is the MINIMUM delta over its own (opcode, branch taken, index page crossed) class, so the steal is exact and every instruction off a badline reads zero. samples are the distinct (frame position, opcode, steal, count) badline hits; writers the PCs whose write cycles the window caught; anchor_9630 the frame position of the marker itself; marker_gap that position less the instruction boundary the raster IRQ was taken at, by the interrupted mnemonic; irq_entry_* the same for all five of a frames raster interrupts; anchor_*/statically_decoded how far the cost models own $XXXX run anchors resolve each BA window to an instruction.
